line: Travellers board an isometric plane, and the order shows why one way is nearly twice as fast.
line_cn: 等距的登机口和机舱里，小人按顺序登机，讲清哪种叫法快将近一半。

camera.serves: a call, a waiting room, a hold to read

camera.move: follow the head of a line
camera.serves: a corridor, a boarding, a procession

camera.move: travel along the ground at the subject's pace
camera.expresses: one place after another on the same road
camera.serves: a delivery, a parade route, a line of workshops

camera.move: rise to wide while a lid opens
camera.serves: an interior, a capacity, a grid of places
a verdict, a comparison, the last frame

camera.move: step back to frame one whole incident
camera.expresses: cause and effect in one view
camera.serves: one person blocking, one door jamming

camera.move: tilt down from outside to the people
camera.serves: an opening, a change of place

transitions: Transitions: a continuous move, a lid opening, a run back along the same path, or a cut on the beat at the same angle.
No page turns, wipes, black or blank frames;
labels: Chinese: a serif (Noto Serif SC, 700 for keywords, 500 for particles); Latin and numerals: a book serif (Newsreader). Open-licence fonts only, subset to the characters used.

Floor type: big ≈ 1.5 m on the ground, small ≈ 0.8 m; read along the up-right axis (coordinates in §10). One phrase per beat; one line where the frame is tight. One accent character or number per phrase, never a single thin stroke (一 in the accent reads as a line, not a character). Characters land ≈ 0.14 s apart: fade and scale 1.22 → 1, pale ghost → ink. A painted title or a pair of numbers may scale up to ×1.6.
Type sits on clear ground: nothing stands on it, nothing raised stands in front of it (see §9), at least 5 % from every frame edge, and clear of the subtitle bar.
Signs in the world (gate signs, group signs, screens) face the camera side of the room at the iso angle, never a flat card facing the lens.
motion: 30 fps, on ones (pass --fps 30 to the render and to mux.sh): crowds and walks are judged frame by frame (§9), and the check assumes this rate.

People move only when the rule says so, in order; the order is the point. Walk ≈ 1.5 m/s; nobody moves faster than about 3 m/s on screen, even in a time-lapse: when a process must be compressed, show it as places filling (people settling into their seats) rather than people zipping past.
Everything eases; nothing pops. A beat = one floor phrase + one diagram mark (an outline traced, an arrow grown ahead of the walkers, a light run along a path) + one action.
A rewind runs the same motion backwards, faster, with a counter running down.

native_moves.name: Floor type
native_moves.does: The key word lands on the ground beside the action.
native_moves.fits: a hospital triage rule; a polling-station step; a library's quiet zone.

native_moves.name: Domino stand-up
native_moves.does: The group called sits together and rises one by one from the near end into a painted lane.
native_moves.fits: an exam hall emptying by row; a ferry deck released lane by lane; a classroom drill.

native_moves.name: Lid off
native_moves.does: A roof flips open on its far hinge, paper side up, and glides away; the camera rises to see the whole inside.
native_moves.fits: a bus at a depot; a lecture hall; a container being packed.

native_moves.name: Order lighting
native_moves.does: Places light up one by one in the order they will be used, before anyone moves.
native_moves.fits: seat assignments; a parking plan; a vaccination queue by number.

native_moves.name: Order arrows
native_moves.does: A flat accent arrow grows ahead of the walkers and branches where each one turns.
native_moves.fits: escalator lanes; recycling bins by type; a one-way museum route.

native_moves.name: Weave fill
native_moves.does: Places fill in a pattern (every other, window first) so the room becomes a woven grid in four colours.
native_moves.fits: a stadium by sections; a cinema with assigned seats; a car park by level.

native_moves.name: Bars on the ground
native_moves.does: Two quantities painted as strips on the floor in proportion, the difference marked by a dashed bracket after a still hold.
native_moves.fits: two queue times; two routes' lengths; before and after a change.

native_moves.name: People as the sample
native_moves.does: The people of a study stand on the ground in the shape of the thing they tested.
native_moves.fits: a 72-person boarding test; a class of 30 in their desk plan; a jury in their box.

native_moves.name: Stand here
native_moves.does: An accent outline or a lit stretch of floor marks the spot that matters.
native_moves.fits: where to wait for a lift; the jammed stretch of an aisle; the right queue at a counter.

score.note: picture-book mallets, one sparkle per landed word
